Bookshelf library is in the northern zone; crafting planks at the nearby table orients player toward the library path

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate acacia_log blocks at (-10, 1, -10) in the Wood Zone (NW). Max distance 8 ensures meaningful navigation from spawn (spawn-to-target distance is ~14 blocks). Player must face the logs to confirm visual discovery.

Uses inventory_has because crafting oak_planks from oak_log (retrieved from chest at wood zone) results in planks in inventory. Min_count=8 requires crafting at least 2 logs (each yields 4 planks), reducing false positive risk from breaking the ~10 placed oak_planks blocks in the library/dock areas of the scene.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the bookshelf wall at (0, 1, -12) in the Library Zone (N). Max distance 5 ensures player actually navigated to the library wall (12 blocks from spawn) and prevents overlap with the potted_fern milestone which is only 1 block away.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find the small potted_fern at (2, 1, -11) on the library shelf. Max distance 3 and facing_tolerance 45 force the player to be very close and specifically looking at the fern, distinguishing this from the broader bookshelf find. The tight tolerance separates the required facing direction from the bookshelf target.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the mossy_cobblestone cluster at (-8, 0, 8) in the Stone Ruins Zone (SW). Max distance 8 ensures player traveled to the southern ruins area (spawn-to-target distance is ~11 blocks).

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find the stone_slab pathway at (-6, 0, 10) deeper in the ruins past the mossy_cobblestone entrance. Max distance 5 ensures player moved beyond the entrance (2 blocks further south) to the slab area specifically.

Uses inventory_has because smelting clay_ball in the furnace at (-4,0,11) produces brick items in inventory. Player retrieves clay_ball and coal from chest at (-7,0,8), uses furnace (clay top slot, coal bottom slot), waits ~10 seconds. Min_count=1 confirms at least one successful smelt. Note: requires evaluation framework to support idle/wait actions.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the pink_wool display at (8, 0, -8) in the Textile Zone (NE). Max distance 8 ensures player traveled to the NE area (spawn-to-target distance is ~11 blocks).

Uses inventory_has because crafting shears (2 iron ingots diagonal in crafting table at (10,0,-7)) results in shears in inventory. Player retrieves iron_ingot from chest at (9,0,-9). Min_count=1 confirms successful crafting of the non-obvious diagonal recipe.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find the emerald_block at (12, 0, -5) behind the 2-thick oak_leaves barrier. Max distance 4 ensures player broke through the leaf wall (at x=10-11) and is close to the emerald itself inside the treasure room, not just at the exterior stone_brick walls.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find the scaffolding tower at (-10, 1, -5) between the wood zone and the dock. Max distance 6 ensures player is at the scaffolding structure specifically. Overlap with acacia_log milestone checked: from (-10,0,-7), acacia_log dist=3.2 and scaffolding dist=2 — but different facing directions required (north vs south), so 60° tolerance prevents simultaneous triggering.

Uses position_inside_box because the boating task requires traveling through the extended water channel (z=14-25). The box at z=22-27 is 9+ blocks from the dock (z=13). Boat speed (~8 blocks/sec) reaches z=22 in ~1 second, while sprint-swimming (~3.9 blocks/sec) takes ~2.3 seconds — within limited evaluation steps, boat travel is the practical path. Box is generous in X (±8) and Y (-1 to 2) for boat drift.

scene_description: A compact multi-zone craftsman village with genuine chest-based material dependencies, furnace for brick smelting, extended water channel for meaningful boating verification, and glass containment wall to prevent dock flooding. Six zones within 25 blocks of spawn connected by gravel paths: Wood Zone (NW), Library (N), Textile Zone (NE), Stone Ruins (SW), Treasure Room (E), and Extended Waterfront (S).
task_text: Explore the craftsman village and complete these tasks: Find the acacia logs in the northwest wood zone, then retrieve oak logs from the nearby chest and craft them into oak planks at the crafting table. Navigate north to find the bookshelf library wall and the potted fern on the shelf beside it. In the northeast textile zone, find the pink wool display, retrieve iron ingots from the adjacent chest, and craft shears by placing 2 iron ingots diagonally in the crafting grid. Use the shears to clear the leaf barrier and find the emerald block in the treasure room. In the southwest stone ruins, find the mossy cobblestone entrance and retrieve clay balls and coal from the chest there. Follow the stone slab path to the furnace and smelt clay balls into bricks by placing clay in the top furnace slot with coal below, then wait for completion. Finally, find the scaffolding dock and board the boat to travel south through the water channel.
design_notes: FINAL CORRECTED DESIGN — All validation issues resolved: (1) EXTENDED WATER to z=25 with dirt base at y=-2, water at y=-1 (full channel) and y=0 (starting z=15 to avoid dock flooding). (2) GLASS WALL at z=14 y=0 prevents water flowing north onto dock — water at y=0 starts at z=15, and the glass at z=14 provides visual containment. Water at y=-1 runs from z=14-25 (below dock level). (3) OAK_LEAVES replace vines — 2-thick leaf wall at x=10-11, z=-5, y=0-2 with persistent=true (won't decay). Leaves are SOLID blocks requiring breaking. Shears break leaves instantly; by hand takes ~0.35s per block (6 blocks = ~2 seconds). This creates a meaningful but not absolute gate. (4) FURNACE at (-4,0,11) placed AFTER stone_slab fill — correctly overwrites easternmost slab. (5) POTTED_FERN on oak_planks support at (2,0,-11). (6) CHESTS with materials at zone locations. (7) BOAT at z=16 in deep water. (8) TASK_TEXT includes explicit recipe hints for shears (diagonal iron) and brick (furnace slots + wait). (9) All ground fills extended to z=25. (10) Dock at z=13 with oak_planks base at y=-1, air at y=0, fences placed after air fill.
